jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Complement builds AI that autonomously operates factories. We connect the fragmented systems inside a factory (ERP, MES, PLCs, spreadsheets, etc) into a unified data layer, then deploy AI agents that optimize decisions across the whole operation for profit.

Core Roles

Data & Integration

Build AI systems that automatically connect to any legacy data source - ERPs, sensors, spreadsheets, custom tools - and turn them into a unified, real-time view of factory operations.

Simulation & Optimization

Run real-time simulations over the global factory state: balance work order demand/load, mitigate delay propagation, identify operational bottlenecks, and justify scheduling prioritizations by quantifying true downstream profit impact.

Manufacturing Systems

Embed with factory operators to map workflows, define and validate interventions, and feed real constraints back so recommendations work in practice.

Human Computer Interaction

Design just-in-time, generative interfaces to make production legible and deliver clear recommendations.

Who We’re Looking For

People who can ship to messy, dynamic environments and are comfortable with the entire abstraction stack: from raw data and high-dimensional models to real-world constraints and quantifiable business impact. We care about what you’ve built under ambiguity and the impact you made.

Who we are

We're a team of eight with backgrounds from Neuralink, Apple, Tesla, McKinsey and the US Army. Backed by First Round Capital, Byers Capital, and Abstract Capital.
